accessibility.calendar: Theme-specific 3D SVGs, a 2D SVG alternative, normalized CSV and textual summary
accessibility.interactive_visuals: GitHub README embeds are static; genuinely interactive views use external links
accessibility.projects: Theme-specific desktop and mobile SVGs, linked Markdown text alternative and JSON source snapshot

refresh.failure_behaviour: The workflow writes only to ephemeral runner storage and publishes nothing. A failed run creates no current asset. Any separately published older asset remains unchanged, and its data-through date continues to age. Local reruns in the same output directory preserve the last valid bundle and pointer.
refresh.last_successful_refresh: For an Actions run, use that run's timestamp. Execution time is kept outside the deterministic bundle.
refresh.recovery: Inspect the failed run, correct the source or validator, then dispatch a new preview. Publish only after a complete successful review and separate owner approval.
refresh.workflow_mode: manual workflow_dispatch until schedule and publication are separately approved

product_screenshots.cadence: Refresh only after a material product change and review
product_screenshots.source_policy: Any added capture must reference a human-reviewed immutable product revision
product_screenshots.state: No product screenshot is included in this generated bundle

projects.cadence: manual preview now; proposed daily after owner approval

public_commits.authentication: No authorization token is sent to the public commit endpoint.
public_commits.cadence: manual preview now; proposed daily after owner approval
public_commits.metric: Distinct commit objects linked to the profile in selected public default branches, bucketed by author timestamp in UTC.
